The '''Spade Forest''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] located on [[Null/Legends|Null]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it was the designated rendezvous point for a meeting between [[Lorian Nod]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
